comment: 29yo female with lifelong moderate isolated thrombocytopenia (platelet count 65-85 x10⁹/L since childhood, refractory to immunosuppressive therapy when misdiagnosed as ITP), referred to hereditary-thrombocytopenia program after pregnancy preconception consult flagged the family history of similar isolated thrombocytopenia in mother + maternal aunt. Targeted inherited-thrombocytopenia germline panel (RUNX1 + ETV6 + ANKRD26 + MYH9 + WAS) returned positive for ANKRD26 5′UTR pathogenic variant (chr10:27,402, established THC2-causing allele). THC2 clinical criteria all met. Engine routes to PreventionPlan: standard = ANKRD26 carrier surveillance — CBC + smear q6mo lifelong, BMA + myeloid NGS at any new cytopenia in non-platelet lineage / persistent dysplasia / emerging blasts, annual bleeding-history + medication review (currently asymptomatic, no antiplatelet exposure), pre-procedure platelet-function-aware hematology consultation when planning her upcoming pregnancy + delivery, cascade germline testing for mother + maternal aunt (already symptomatic, will benefit from formal genetic confirmation) + future children; alternative = intensified track with q3-month CBC during pregnancy + perioperative windows, scheduled BMA every 3-5 years from confirmation, pre-emptive HLA-typing of sibling cohort + germline-testing of all candidates, structured multidisciplinary obstetric-hematology plan for delivery.
